Name: Shallum, Son of Tikvath
Summary: Shallum, son of Tikvath son of Hasrah and keeper of the wardrobe, was the husband of Huldah the prophetess, who dwelt in Jerusalem in the college.
KeyStory: Huldah was the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe.
RelatedPeople: Huldah, the Prophetess; Tikvath, Father of Shallum
LifeLesson: A prophetess's husband kept the wardrobe; God speaks through ordinary households.
